root_cause_criterion.criterion: `PackLinuxElf64::canUnpack()` must reject inputs whose parsed ELF64 program-header count is smaller than two before later unpack logic can assume `phdri[1]` exists.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable program admits the staged file even though its header says `e_phnum == 1`. The fixed program adds the missing `e_phnum >= 2` admission check at `PackLinuxElf64::canUnpack()` and prevents the later second-program-header dereference on the stock PoC.

nodes.state: When the vulnerable path reaches the second C_BASE conjunct, the 8-byte span starting at `&phdri[1].p_offset` extends past the allocated ELF-header image, so the read target is out of bounds before it is forwarded into the endian helper chain.
The sanitizer sink executes `upx_memcpy_inline(&v, p, sizeof(v))`, i.e. the helper performs the 8-byte read from the pointer forwarded from the second-program-header access.

edges.relation: The same parsed program-header count that should have been rejected at `canUnpack()` is reloaded in `unpack()` and reaches the second-program-header dereference unchanged.
The out-of-bounds pointer formed for the nonexistent second program header is the same pointer ultimately consumed by `get_ne64()` at the heap-buffer-overflow sink.
